quadrature.upper: left rectangles with each 1/P(jh) rounded up before summation, plus the rational upper tail

diagnostics: SciPy quad and logarithmic closed-form values are floating diagnostics with no mathematical status.

limitations: The analytical scalar-reduction theorem is reviewed separately.
